continuation_contract.executed_remesh: Preserved except when a new remesh stage actually applies new settings.
continuation_contract.executed_mesh_generation: Preserved size, Steiner limit and boundary/volume acceptance settings; runtime caps remain applied checks.
continuation_contract.executed_refinement: Recorded explicitly; a new refinement can apply new guides/radius/resource bounds.
continuation_contract.completed_settings: Transitive completed_geometry_settings separate executed geometry from planned configuration values.
continuation_contract.actual_contacts: Bound parent metadata must match its declared centres, areas, provenance, scenarios and group order. No automatic rebuilding/reprojection across preparation stages.

CEM_contract.input: Completed generic mesh artifact with passed fixed mesh QC, bound contact metadata, nodes/tets/boundary file and ordered-array SHA identities; no CT array reload or material integration in this stage.
CEM_contract.physical_presence: Each scenario requires present_contact_ids. Only these participate in patch ownership and CEM assembly. Unassigned present pads have individual floating ports with zero external current; absent candidate positions are not electrodes.
CEM_contract.IDs: Original strings retained as values in lists of scenario/group/pad records. No MATLAB struct-field encoding of IDs.
CEM_contract.area_support: Different nominal I/U areas supported by collective canonical calls at each unique area, selecting each pad's matching result. Mixed patches must be node-disjoint and pass QC; this conservative method may reject a feasible placement.
CEM_contract.impedance_support: Explicit positive per-physical z_contact in ohm m^2 plus source/assumption; canonical per-pad matrix then T-transpose K T for grouped potentials. Different z_contact inside a group are retained.
CEM_contract.geometry: Raw, original surface projection, source surface projection and actual FEM boundary projection remain distinct. Actual projection distance and source-to-FEM displacement bounded explicitly.
CEM_contract.patch_QC: Induced faces, node IDs, edge connectivity, actual/nominal area, area-weighted centroid, maximum vertex extent, node overlap, actual boundary IDs; no nearest-node replacement or threshold relaxation.
CEM_contract.other_areas: Explicit per-case extent threshold and justification required; area/centroid upper limits retained.
CEM_contract.matrix_QC: SI geometry scaling, per-physical canonical contact matrix, grouped/floating ports, ordered plus/minus unit-current and readout patterns; symmetry and constant-vector-null checks. No bulk PDE solve.
